_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for closed-loop-vref-trim-mc on the `klt sim` decks transport (issue #423, Part of #412). Mechanics: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py; argument: this file. `@@N@@` is filled and `msense_w` added by `sim/harness/trim_mc_klt.py spec`. The report handed to the adapter is the campaign's digest shaped as a corner report (one row per point; trim_mc_klt.py assemble); the per-draw rows are the companion records/<id>-draws.csv.
Experiment: closed-loop-vref-trim-mc (issue #229; klt sim decks transport, issue #423)
Claim: After a modeled 1-point 27 C trim (per-die trim code chosen at the die's own corner from a 3-code linearity-verified fit, targeting DR-0011's 1.050 V TC-null point), the closed-loop vref of N=@@N@@ seeded device-mismatch draws stays inside the +/-0.5% trimmed line over -40...125 C -- the trimmed-line evidence DR-0011's Output-reference row obligates (kept by DR-0014). Digest CSV carries each point's frac_within_0.5%, 3-sigma and worst per-draw deviation, the code* distribution (mean/sigma/min/max, railed count) and the measured per-die trim unit (mV) with its linearity residual; per-draw data is in records/<id>-draws.csv. Negative control: same seeds against plain sections trim to EXACTLY zero spread (hard gate, as in sim/closed-loop-vref-mc). A point whose 3-sigma exceeds 0.5% is graded FAIL: the CSV is the measurement, not a pass/fail claim about the design.
Devices: All real PDK compact models; the DUT is the trim-bearing bandgap_core (R1 base l=37.2u + XXTRIM ladder, 255 binary-weighted rppd units + strap links, all inside the mismatch draw), plus bandgap_amp and bandgap_startup verbatim.
Netlist provenance: design/netlist/bandgap_core.spice, bandgap_trim.spice, bandgap_amp.spice and bandgap_startup.spice, carried verbatim into testbench/tb_closed_loop_vref_trim_mc.spice.tmpl (unchanged by the klt conversion; each deck is that template rendered by sim/harness/trim_mc_klt.py with the same substitutions run_trim_mc.sh made; the representative deck of each point is re-rendered with host-resolvable PDK paths -- the fleet ran the identical deck against the image's baked PDK root).
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models baked into the batch runner image (#277).
Corner matrix run: points {typ mismatch, typ negative control, bcs mismatch, wcs mismatch} x N=@@N@@ seeded draws x 6 decks per draw (3 fit codes {0,1,255} at 27 C + code* at {-40, 27, 125} C), submitted as two `decks` stages (fit, then verify with host-computed code*) -- digested to one row per point
author: Loom Builder (agent), issue #423
